All fixtures in this public repository are synthetic. They contain no account credentials, device identifiers, apartment readings or private exports.

Balance fields follow the statically traced app models. The decreasing `aa_day` values in `balance-block-average.json` exercise comparison-average preservation; they must not produce cumulative-counter reset warnings.

SALUS pages follow the retained official OpenAPI schema. Unequal per-property counts exercise pagination. `salus-it700-scale.json` tests independent, explicitly configured property divisors; its numbers do not establish a live scale. Missing interpretations must exclude temperature metrics.

Balance hourly ordering, physical interval boundaries, missing-hour behavior and DST semantics remain unverified. Tests enforce exclusion of unverified hourly rows and use explicitly synthetic confirmation to exercise the elapsed-hour path. No fixture should be cited as live household evidence.
